items.title: Rising gas prices frustrate voters; Trump calls them an 'inexpensive price to pay' for Iran war
items.title_zh: 选民怒油价：特朗普称此为伊战“廉价代价”
items.summary_zh: ABC/美联社：AAA普通汽油全国均价约4.48美元，一周涨约17美分；福克斯民调61%选民视油价为家庭重大问题，63%认为本届政府使经济恶化。特朗普称高油价是伊战“廉价代价”。密歇根经营者称柴油加注约6.79——中期选举早期投票已开，油箱政治升温。

quotes.author: ABC News / AP
quotes.en: Rising gas prices frustrate voters. Trump says it's an 'inexpensive price to pay' for the Iran war.
quotes.zh: 油价上涨激怒选民。特朗普称这是伊战“廉价的代价”。

items.title: Black Holes or Black Hole Stars? Astronomers Spar over 'Little Red Dots'
items.title_zh: 黑洞还是黑洞星？天文学家争论‘小红点’
items.summary_zh: Quanta写早期宇宙‘小红点’究竟是黑洞还是奇异恒星的争论；评论吐槽大众恒星观与天文学定义之差，并玩笑“黑洞太阳”才是该有的名字。

quotes.author: jahnu
quotes.en: One thing worth noting is our popular notion of what a star seems to be is quite different from what astronomers have.
quotes.zh: 值得一提：大众心里的“恒星”和天文学家用的概念差很远。

quotes.author: benji-york
quotes.en: Any decent human being would have called these Black Hole Suns.
quotes.zh: 正常人类早该叫它们黑洞太阳了。

items.title: Trump set to address the UN General Assembly, with Iran in focus
items.title_zh: 联大辩论在即：特朗普周二演讲聚焦伊朗与海合会会晤
items.summary_zh: Scripps：特朗普定周二联大演讲，官员称将谈伊朗永不拥核、西半球与加沙20点方案等；伊核与地区安全为会谈核心。同期将与海合会领导人会晤。Axios此前引特朗普“歼灭或收手”重大决定——联大周把军事抉择、制裁执行与签证外交叠在同一舞台。

quotes.author: Scripps News
quotes.en: Iran is expected to be a "key topic of conversation and diplomacy," according to senior U.S. officials.
quotes.zh: 据美国高级官员，伊朗料将成为“对话与外交的关键议题”。

items.title: One-Electron Universe
items.summary_zh: 维基‘单电子宇宙’假说热传；评论推荐Andy Weir《蛋》，并延伸‘单观察者宇宙’——所有观察者是同一意识穿越时空的显现。

quotes.author: stared
quotes.en: In the line, I recommend "The Egg" by Andy Weir https://www.galactanet.com/oneoff/theegg_mod.html
quotes.zh: 顺着这条线，推荐Andy Weir的《蛋》。

quotes.author: lioeters
quotes.en: A twist on this theory: One-Observer Universe. It is the hypothesis that all observers are actually manifestations of a single observer experiencing all of time, space, and every perspective.
quotes.zh: 变体：单观察者宇宙——假说所有观察者其实是同一个观察者在体验全部时间、空间与视角。

items.title: CENTCOM reports 1 billion barrels escorted through Hormuz but LNG transit holds near zero
items.title_zh: CENTCOM称护送十亿桶过峡：LNG过境仍近冰点、与官方口径差约五百万桶/日
items.summary_zh: EnergyReader对照：CENTCOM称自五月护送逾两千艘商船、至多十亿桶原油过霍尔木兹；赖特9月13日口径约千万桶/日，Kpler初九月可见流量约五百万桶/日，口径差约一半。天然气过境自约10.5降至约0.8 bcf/日（约基线8%），亚洲JKM约27.51美元/MMBtu——原油叙事回暖难掩LNG结构性断裂。

quotes.author: EnergyReader
quotes.en: Gas transits through the strait fell from 10.5 billion cubic feet per day to about 0.8 bcf/d, roughly 8% of the pre-crisis baseline.
quotes.zh: 经海峡的天然气过境从每天约105亿立方英尺降至约8亿，约为危机前基线的8%。

items.title: Suzanne Ciani's Buchla Cookbook
items.summary_zh: Orpheus Institute整理电子音乐先驱Ciani的Buchla模块食谱；模块合成与VCV Rack玩家欢呼，并指向Tiptop与Buchla的Eurorack复刻。

quotes.author: outofpaper
quotes.en: This is an amazing resource, whether you're into hardware modular synths or virtual ones like VCV Rack and Cardinal. Read, learn, enjoy, and play.
quotes.zh: 无论你玩硬件模块合成还是VCV Rack/Cardinal这类虚拟机，这都是宝库。读、学、玩、享受。

quotes.author: harmoni-pet
quotes.en: Tiptop Audio has a collaboration with Buchla where they're making eurorack versions of most of the classic models.
quotes.zh: Tiptop Audio与Buchla合作，把多数经典型号做成Eurorack版本。

items.title: U.S. clears way for $24.3 billion F-35 sale to Saudi Arabia
items.title_zh: 美放行对沙243亿美元F-35可能军售：48架战机国会审查中
items.summary_zh: 路透：国务院批准可能向沙特出售48架F-35A及配套发动机与支援，总额约243亿美元，国会有三十日审议期。时点紧贴美拒直接打胡塞之后——以军售代出兵，给利雅得防空与威慑工具，同时把美国留在红海第二战场之外。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: The U.S. State Department has approved a possible $24.3 billion sale of F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia.
quotes.zh: 美国国务院已批准可能向沙特出售价值约243亿美元的F-35战斗机交易。

items.title: Security Alert: U.S. Mission Saudi Arabia – September 19, 2026
items.title_zh: 美驻沙特使团安全提醒：利雅得遇袭后吁加强警惕并预留离境弹性
items.summary_zh: 美驻沙特使团9月19日安全提醒：地区紧张下安全环境复杂、或有突发升级；在中东的美国人应提高警惕，预做航班取消、空域关闭与旅行中断准备，并直接向航司核对利雅得/吉达/达兰机场动态。提醒点名伊朗支持的胡塞对沙包括民用机场的敌对行动，冲突或迅速升级——首都告警进入领事口径。

quotes.author: U.S. Mission Saudi Arabia
quotes.en: Americans currently in the Middle East should exercise heightened vigilance and be aware of potential flight cancellations, airspace closures, and travel disruptions.
quotes.zh: 目前身处中东的美国人应提高警惕，并留意可能的航班取消、空域关闭与旅行中断。

items.title: Telling a Computer to Do Things
items.summary_zh: Will Keleher谈壳脚本与“让计算机做事”的接口心智；评论认为管道/进程组合比语言本身更关键，并劝新手给学壳留足时间。

quotes.author: adityaathalye
quotes.en: IMO, a scripting language is the lesser contributor to the power of shell scripting. My ranked-order is: 1. Universal Inter-Process Interface: Arbitrary program composition via pipes.
quotes.zh: 我觉得脚本语言对壳脚本威力的贡献反而较小。我的排序：1.通用进程间接口——用管道任意组合程序。

quotes.author: happyPersonR
quotes.en: Learning and getting good at shell scripting is something that takes a while usually. I would recommend that people new at shell give themselves time.
quotes.zh: 学会并精通壳脚本通常要花一阵子。建议新手给自己留足时间。
